maddeler.e:
تمايلت (form VI)
# تَمَايَلْتُ (tamāyaltu) /ta.maː.jal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# تَمَايَلْتَ (tamāyalta) /ta.maː.jal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# تَمَايَلْتِ (tamāyalti) /ta.maː.jal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# تَمَايَلَتْ (tamāyalat) /ta.maː.ja.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
